隐私条款

你的家中物品记录留在自己的设备上。这里说明数据如何保存、哪些功能会使用外部服务，以及你如何管理这些选择。

隐私协议更新：2026年11月15日网页整理日期：2026年11月22日
本页目录
  1. 保存到这台设备上
  2. 账号与广告

由你决定，保存在何处。无需账号，没有广告。语音默认在本机识别；帮助改进与付费版备份默认关闭。

01保存到这台设备上

物品名称、位置、数量和你说的原话保存在这台设备上，一直保留到你删掉对应记录、清除本应用数据，或卸载本应用。语音默认只在本机识别。只有你同意，本机识别不了的那一句才会发给苹果。可以在「交互」里改回只在本机。

02账号与广告

本应用现在按单机使用，暂无账号。不会使用或出售你的信息。没有广告。

03帮助改进

「帮助改进」默认关闭。打开后只统计用了哪些功能，不会包含物品名称、位置和你说的原话。

04版本更新

应用会向苹果查询 App Store 上的版本号，用来提示是否有更新。查询不包含物品名称、位置和你说的原话。

05备份

备份属于付费版。免费版不能选择文件夹、自动备份、导出或从备份恢复。买断后备份默认关闭。你若打开，加密文件会存到你选的文件夹，一直保留到你自己删掉这个文件。若文件夹里已有备份且比当前账本物品更多，不会静默覆盖，需你确认恢复或覆盖；选文件夹时取消也会关掉自动备份。选择 iCloud 云盘时，文件会进入你的 iCloud。卸载本应用不会自动删掉这份备份。退款后备份入口会关闭，已经保存的文件仍留在原处。

06你自己能处理的事

记录可以在应用里删除。帮助改进可以在「设置」里关闭。备份文件由你在所选文件夹里删除。卸载本应用会清掉这台设备上的记录，不会自动删除备份。

07如何联系我们

关于本隐私协议，请写到 whereabout.feedback@gmail.com。

08更新日期

本隐私协议于 2026年11月15日更新。此后若有修改，以应用内展示的文本为准。

需要帮助？

隐私、条款或使用上的问题，都可以写信给我们。

whereabout.feedback@gmail.com

Privacy policy Instructions & terms

Whereabout / PRODUCT & SUPPORT

Privacy policy

Your household records stay on your own device. Here is how data is saved, which features use external services, and how you control those choices.

Privacy policy updated: 15 November 2026Web edition: 22 November 2026
On this page
  1. On this device
  2. Account and ads
  3. Help Improve
  4. Updates
  5. Backup
  6. What you can do
  7. Contact
  8. Updated

You choose where your records live.No account. No ads. Speech is on device by default; Help Improve and paid-plan backup are off by default.

01On this device

Item names, locations, quantities, and what you say stay on this device until you delete the record, erase the app’s data, or delete the app. Speech stays on the phone unless you agree to send a sentence that on-device recognition can’t handle. You can switch back to on-device only in Interaction.

02Account and ads

The app is used on this device alone for now, and there is no account. Your information is not used or sold. There are no ads.

03Help Improve

Help Improve is off by default. When it is on, it counts which features are used. Item names, locations, and what you said are not included.

04Updates

The app asks Apple for the App Store version so it can tell you when an update is available. That request does not include item names, locations, or what you said.

05Backup

Backup is part of the paid plan. The free plan can’t choose a folder, turn on automatic backup, export a file, or restore. After you buy it, backup stays off until you choose a folder. The file is encrypted and remains there until you delete that file. If the folder already has a backup with more item kinds than this phone, it is not overwritten silently—you confirm restore or overwrite. Canceling when a backup is found also turns automatic backup off. If you choose iCloud Drive, the file is stored in your iCloud. Deleting the app does not delete that backup. After a refund, backup closes and a file already saved stays where it is.

06What you can do

You can delete records in the app, and turn off Help Improve in Settings. Delete a backup file in the folder you chose. Deleting the app clears the records on this device and does not delete that backup.

07Contact

For this privacy policy, write to whereabout.feedback@gmail.com.

08Updated

This privacy policy was updated on 15 November 2026. If it changes, the text shown in the app applies.

Need a hand?

Email us with questions about privacy, these terms, or using the app.

whereabout.feedback@gmail.com
